Every snapshot protocol whose token already trades (mcap_usd set) is an anchor: ln(mcap/tvl) regressed on clamped 7-day growth and log age by least squares, outliers trimmed once beyond 1.5 log units, a deterministic 20% holdout scores the fit out of sample, house constants as fallback.
